description: Update an existing post by ID: title, content, excerpt, status, slug, date or custom fields. Pass the fields to change in fields and custom fields in meta_input. Set schedule_for to schedule publication. Passing post_category replaces all of the post's categories.

ID.description: The ID of the post to update.

meta_input.description: Custom fields as key/value pairs. Keys starting with an underscore (WordPress internals) are refused, except the Yoast SEO title, description and focus keyphrase.

schedule_for.description: Schedule post for future publication. Provide local datetime (e.g., "2026-02-02 09:00:00"). Automatically sets status to "future" and calculates GMT from WordPress timezone.

name: wp_update_post
title: Update post
